description: Create an inbound connector: a signed public endpoint that turns external events (CI failures, alerts, calendars) into Delega tasks (admin only). The sender signs each POST body with HMAC-SHA256 (header X-Delega-Ingress-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex of HMAC(secret, 't.body')>, 5-minute tolerance). Ingress can ONLY create tasks; routing (project/assignee) is pinned here and never payload-controlled; every created task carries the 'ingress' label and provenance marker, and automation rules ignore ingress tasks unless they explicitly opt in with a source=ingress condition. Hosted API only.

active.description: Set false to create the source disabled

default_assignee_agent_id.description: Assignee for created tasks (pinned; payload cannot override)

default_project_id.description: Project for created tasks (pinned; payload cannot override)

filters.description: Only deliveries passing all filters create tasks

items.description: One filter; all filters must pass (AND) or the delivery is skipped

path.description: Dot-path into the payload, e.g. workflow.conclusion or runs.0.status

template.description: Maps payload paths to task fields — a closed vocabulary, no expressions

content.description: Task title template. {{dot.path}} placeholders resolve against the payload; only primitives render

dedupe_key.description: Idempotency key template, e.g. {{run.id}} — retried deliveries with the same key create no duplicate. Default: hash of the raw body

labels.description: Static labels; the 'ingress' provenance label is always added

name: create_ingress_source
